questions.question: Briefly explain the preparation of traditional Indian sweets like peda and burfi. / [CO4]
questions.solution_html: • Briefly explain the preparation of traditional Indian sweets like peda and burfi. Peda :- Broken the Koha into bits, Mix with sugar, Put into a Pan and cook over a very slow fire, pour into a greased tray. After cool and set, cut into desired size and shape. Burfi :- 4 to 5 litres of buffalo milk is heated in a stainless-steel kettle with constant stirring to prevent scorching. When semisolid consistency is reached, stop heating, and add powdered sugar, mix well using a wooden ladle until uniform, smooth mass is formed. Then, pour the mixture into a greased tray. questions.question: What is beeswax? / [CO1]
questions.solution_html: • What is beeswax? Beeswax is a natural wax produced by honeybees by using their four pairs of wax glands situated on the anterior part of the worker’s last four normal sternal plates. Bees secrete it as a liquid that hardens into scales upon contact with air, and they use these scales to build the hexagonal cells of their honeycomb. It is composed mainly of esters of fatty acids and long-chain alcohols, free fatty acids, hydrocarbons and other minor components (eg. Carotenoids, propolis etc.). (Definition-2 Marks, Composition- 1 mark) [K] / [CO1]

questions.question: Explain the process of honey production in honeybees. / [CO1]
questions.solution_html: • Explain the process of honey production in honeybees. Honeybees collect nectar from flowers, storing in stomach where enzymes begin to convert it into honey, deposit the partially-transformed nectar into honeycomb cells, fan it with their wings to evaporate excess water until it becomes thick honey, which is then sealed with a wax cap. (1 Mark to each step) [K] / [CO1]
